name: internetresearch
description: Atlas Relay – connect RIPE Atlas users who need measurement credits with users who have them

scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n azurite,api,web,swa -c blue,green,magenta,cyan "npm run azurite" "npm run api" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run swa"
scripts.api: npm run build -w api && cd api && func start --port 7071
